name: Starlight Princess

features.name: Multipliers
features.description: Multiplier symbols worth up to 500x can land on any spin.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 15 free spins where all landing multipliers add to a total applied to subsequent wins.

review:
Gates of Olympus's anime sister. Pay-anywhere tumbles on a 6x5 grid, multiplier symbols that land during tumbles, and free spins where the multipliers really build up.

The maths and features are almost identical to Gates, so choosing between them is mostly about which look you prefer. If you already play Gates, this will feel familiar straight away. Very high volatility, 5,000x max, 96.5% RTP.
cons: Nearly identical to Gates of Olympus
